svg.aria-label: Fast arcade shooter: Multi-stage boss fights and bullet hells in a neon arena. CRT look: One hand-written WGSL shader: scanlines, vignette, barrel distortion. Native and browser: Runs native on Windows, macOS and Linux, and in the browser via WebAssembly. No asset files: Sprites are shapes. Audio is synthesized. No asset files ship with the game. Open source, MIT: Open source under the MIT License. CI on every push: CI (https://github.com/VelimirMueller/lab-arcade-shooter/actions/workflows/ci.yml) checks format, lints and tests on every push and pull request to main
